system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Shame on . To this day Spotify is unable to rearrange playlists on Android. A lot of complaints in the forum and they just don't bother answering.

PREDICTED INTENT: playlist_library

PRECEDENTS:

[2288651] (similarity 0.77, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: Would be great to see rearrange songs in a play list on Android. Spotify has the best organizer tools on desktop. Mobile please 😌
  spotify replied: Hi Joseph! We understand your frustration. Rest assured, we monitor all feedback in our Community. We'll post any updates there

[2751304] (similarity 0.76, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: #Android #app still broken. Can't reorder #songs in #playlist .. #Spotify
  spotify replied: Hey again! Don't worry, our devs are constantly checking all feedback posted in our Community. Hopefully this is something we'll be able to implement in the future. Let us know if you need anything else

[1928888] (similarity 0.76, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: Really wish you could sort playlists on the app by which ones you have/haven't downloaded. #Spotify
  spotify replied: Hi there! Nice idea, it's definitely something for the team to consider. We'll be sure to let them know it's something you'd like to see

[1211743] (similarity 0.74, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: Spotify won't shuffle my playlists on my phone anymore nd it's annoying
  spotify replied: Hey! Don't worry, help's here. What phone model, operating system, and Spotify version are you using? We'll see what we can suggest

[1630505] (similarity 0.74, intent playlist_library)
  past customer: has left Android and Chromebook users out in the cold for years. No rearranging playlists, a critical feature of any music player.
  spotify replied: Hey there, we hear you! Be sure to suggest your idea in our Community at <link> and get support from other users

Draft the reply as JSON.
